summary: Examples of the ini lookup reading users per section, a properties file key, all keys matching a regex, and a MySQL ini file with allow_no_value.
questions: How do I read the user from the production section of users.ini?
How do I loop over all keys in an INI section?
How do I read user.name from a properties file?

answer_card.title: ini lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug: msg="User in integration is {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.ini', 'user', section='integration', file='users.ini') }}"

- ansible.builtin.debug: msg="user.name is {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.ini', 'user.name', type='properties', file='user.properties') }}"

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ q('ansible.builtin.ini', '.*', section='section1', file='test.ini', re=True) }}"

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.ini', 'user', file='mysql.ini', section='mysqld', allow_no_value=True) }}"
```
